text: The toy rabbit was missing. Theo said, “I need the toy rabbit.” Nora told Theo, “I can help you.” Nora borrowed the lantern. Theo said, “I am afraid.” She stayed beside Theo. He heard the brass bell. Nora handed Theo the lantern. She freed the toy rabbit from the pine branch. She handed the toy rabbit to Theo. Theo returned the lantern to Dad. Theo held the toy rabbit beside the tent. Theo smiled.
